text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Grass 
Wonder...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Trainer-san, there are Umamusume 
plushies. They look like crane game 
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of girls are there. It 
sounds a bit noisy, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is deeply curious, but she 
seems a bit intimidated by the lively 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can't see very well from here. I wonder 
if they have plushies of Spe-chan and El 
too?
choice_data_list: I'll go get it for you!
I'll go get it for you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I feel bad just watching from the 
sidelines. If there's any way I could help 
out and work hard alongside you..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it sounds like I can be of 
help. Understood. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering you on with all my heart. 
Best of luck to you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
